notes: TVA single rate 18% (CGI art. 195, via InterCom Togo, the official trade portal compiling OTR data; the CGI PDF on otr.tg itself could not be opened). Bullion VAT null: the portal summary of the art. 180 exemption list mentions no gold, but it is a summary ('in particular'), not the full annex text. Note: art. 243 excise on precious stones and metals is 15% (excise, not VAT). Duty null.
